sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Hare Krishna Tripathi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
No one appears for the informant despite service of notice.
2. The FIR in question was lodged as missing person report.
Subsequently in the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she had gone out of her own freewill.
A supplementary affidavit has been filed showing the education certificate bearing the date of birth 02.04.2004.
3. The issue with regard to the age is to be determined at the time of trial.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the submissions that the parties are residing as husband and wife and the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., prima facie, does not support the prosecution story; the applicant who is in custody since 15.12.2022 and has no criminal antecedents, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Karan Kushwaha be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.04 of 2023 (Sessions Case No.218 of 2023), under Sections 363, 366, 376, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Baruasagar, District Jhansi on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
